# Structure1 Construction

> Structure1 Construction is a licensed and insured residential construction and outdoor living contractor based in Dallas, serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex in Texas. We design and build custom patio covers, concrete, stamped concrete, driveways and walkways, complete outdoor living spaces, and select remodels and additions. 150+ projects completed, 2-year workmanship warranty, permits and engineering handled, free on-site estimates. Website: https://structure1builds.com

## Services

- [All Services](https://structure1builds.com/services): Six services from one in-house crew
- [Patio Covers](https://structure1builds.com/services/patio-covers): Gable, lean-to, and polycarbonate patio covers, $8,000–$25,000+, engineered for Texas wind with permits included
- [Concrete](https://structure1builds.com/services/concrete): Patios, slabs, driveways, and replacements engineered for North Texas clay soil; broom finish $7–$11/sq ft
- [Stamped Concrete](https://structure1builds.com/services/stamped-concrete): Ashlar slate, random stone, wood plank, and brick patterns, $12–$22/sq ft installed
- [Driveways & Walkways](https://structure1builds.com/services/driveways-walkways): 5–6 inch reinforced driveways, walkways, and tear-out replacements
- [Outdoor Living](https://structure1builds.com/services/outdoor-living): Cover, patio, lighting, and fans designed and built as one project
- [Remodeling & New Builds](https://structure1builds.com/services/remodeling): Additions, backyard transformations, and interior remodels in select DFW markets

## Key Facts

- Serves: Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Arlington, Carrollton, Flower Mound, Prosper, and 10+ more DFW cities
- Patio covers typically cost $8,000–$25,000+ in DFW; most projects complete in 2–4 weeks
- Stamped concrete runs $12–$22 per square foot installed in DFW
- Permits and engineering are handled by Structure1 in every DFW municipality
- All structures built with Western Red Cedar on steel-anchored, engineered footings
- 2-year workmanship warranty on every project; free itemized estimates
